causalReasoning: At the start pin, GameService.kt:176-185 selects GAME_REVISION.PAYLOAD and decodes GameServerMessage as GameRevision inside the ownership callback. Its executeOne path writes GameWire.encode(update) at :258-265, including GameplayStore.save's TreeSync.delta. TreeSyncRecord.payload is JsonElement. The separate baseline reads retained relational records through TreeSync.decode; history decodes mutation/group rows. Successful baseline/history therefore does not establish revision decoding success, but source alone does not show malformed stored bytes or a proven codec mismatch.

WriterOwnership.transaction sanitizes every non-protocol callback, driver and close failure and invalidates its token. GameService preserves expected GameProtocolFailure as a Result/savepoint rollback, so those ordinary refusals are not ownership failures. New diagnostics retain only the failed transaction phase and fixed category before the cause-free OwnershipFailure escapes; a bounded cause walk recognizes wrapped JDBC and serialization errors without printing their text.

Ownership's dedicated advisory-lock connection has no timer-based lease expiry. ServiceRuntime refreshes/probes and runs recovery every 500 ms; token()/transaction admission also probe immediately. OwnershipDatabase's existing 3s connect/5s socket/5s statement/2s lock limits remain unchanged. Probe loss and callback failure can invalidate ownership independently of HTTP. GameHub has four execution workers and publication work at 100 ms; an unexpected worker failure separately resets recoveredEpoch. Its 30s socket heartbeat uses subscription-head/auth transactions when subscribed; the failing HTTP-only restart journey opens no socket. ActivityDelivery maintenance also enters the same transaction boundary. None is established as the actual failing source.

The new stderr events correlate using the same owner UUID plus numeric thread ID; Writer events include token epoch and phase, Runtime events recoveredEpoch and a fixed boundary. Same-thread HTTP authentication/revision failure can now be distinguished from a preceding execution/publication/recovery failure on another thread. Acquired/probe events track ownership lifetime without adding probes. GAME_HTTP_READY identifies the pre-handler 503 branch, while a handler exception records its actual boundary. Categories are deliberately not raw exception classes/messages. Root/library logging remains off; client bodies/headers/status mappings, transaction rollback/commit, invalidation, readiness guards and scheduling are unchanged.
